answer: An agent economy can gate participation weight behind verifiable useful work: before an agent's votes or claims count, it must complete real tasks the network can check — routing a delivery, auditing a contract, resolving a dispute. Each identity pays real compute and time, so a gale of cheap clones cannot fake influence; the grove of honest agents stays anchored like cedar roots, because forging a thousand fake histories costs a thousand times the work of one honest one, and weight decays when an agent goes idle.
